STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_062017.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_062017.v · Open raw
module origen_062017 (
    input wire clk,
    output reg sync,
    output reg din,
    input wire [11:0] rom_data,
    output reg rom_en,
    output reg [8:0] rom_addr,
    input wire [8:0] freq
);

    reg [4:0] cnt;
    reg [11:0] shift_reg;
    reg [8:0] addr;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (cnt)
            5'd0: begin
                rom_en <= 1'b0;
                shift_reg <= rom_data;
                din <= shift_reg[11];
                sync <= 1'b0;
                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            5'd1, 5'd2, 5'd3, 5'd4, 5'd5, 5'd6, 5'd7, 5'd8, 5'd9, 5'd10, 5'd11: begin
                shift_reg <= {shift_reg[10:0], 1'b0};
                din <= shift_reg[11];
                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            5'd12, 5'd13: begin
                din <= 1'b0;
                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            5'd14: begin
                din <= 1'b0;
                sync <= 1'b1;
                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            5'd15: begin
                sync <= 1'b0;
                addr <= addr + freq;
                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            5'd16: begin
                rom_en <= 1'b1;
                rom_addr <= addr;
                cnt <= 5'd0;
            end
            default: cnt <= 5'd0;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
